definition: ConcreteEmptyFact A C e says e is true exactly where no roster member satisfies supplied Concrete predicate C. This does not imply no one exists. ConcreteMaker separately restricts every maker to that C extension. abstractArena has an existing eligible maker and no concrete candidates.
note: Stipulated concrete-only control; there is no independent analysis of concreteness. Generalization to reality and the legitimacy of abstract makers remain OPEN. It prevents an illicit inference from concrete absence to absolute absence.
